Your apps and tools, one click away

Choose a tool from the island and use it right away. No extra windows to find.

Clock, weather, and world clocks

Check your local time and weather, and see what time it is in other cities.

  • Add another city whenever you need one
  • See things you've copied recently

PC performance

See how your processor (CPU), graphics, memory, and storage are doing. Live charts help you spot changes. You can also check your battery and how long your PC has been on.

  • Colors show when your PC is working hard
  • See your PC's name at the top

Timer and focus sessions

Need to focus? Pick a timer or try a Pomodoro: 25 minutes of work, then a 5-minute break. Start, stop, or reset whenever you need.

  • Timer options: 1, 5, 10, 15, 25, or 60 minutes
  • Choose whether the timer shows minutes

Things you've copied

See what you copied recently. Click an item to copy it again. Handy for links, commands, and text you use often.

Notes

Write down a thought, command, or reminder. Your notes stay on your PC, ready when you need them.

Task manager

See which apps use the most memory. Close one with the X, or use Run program to open an app.

Music controls and song search

Control your music and volume without leaving what you're doing. Tap Listen to find out what's playing, then copy the song name or search for it on YouTube.

  • Shuffle or repeat songs, or use the mini-player
  • Controls the audio playing on your PC

Connect with Discord and Roblox

See useful Discord and Roblox info in Hyperisland. Your connection details stay on your PC.

Discord

In your Discord app settings, set http://localhost as the redirect URL. Add your Client ID and Client Secret, then choose Save & Connect. You don't need a bot or webhook.

Roblox

While you play Roblox, see the game's name and your ping (how long your connection takes to respond). You can also view recent games and the server's region.

Set it up in a few steps

Get Hyperisland ready to use in just a few steps. It checks for updates and tells you when it's up to date.

  2. Open it and follow the steps.
  3. Open Hyperisland and choose a feature.

Questions

Will Hyperisland slow down my PC?

It's designed to stay out of your way when you're not using it. You can see how much memory it uses in the Tasks module.

Where does Hyperisland save my data?

Your clipboard history and connection details stay on your PC.

Why does song search say “Nothing playing”?

Start playing audio on your PC, then choose Listen again.

Why can't I see the Roblox server location?

This info comes from Voidstrap. If it's not available, the rest of the panel still works.
